# skeleton_shimmer

Shimmer loading effect and skeleton loaders for Flutter. One sweep shared across every placeholder, API-compatible with the shimmer package, and reduced-motion aware.

pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/skeleton_shimmer
source: https://github.com/Yusufihsangorgel/skeleton_shimmer

## Before you call it

README.md carries the usage, the measured comparison against the alternatives, and a note on when not to reach for this package.

## Layout

- `lib/` — public API
- `example/` — runnable examples
- `test/` — the suite; `dart test` (or `flutter test`) runs it
